description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Steering Knuckle Rebuild Kit and includes BOTH Sides!
This economical kit gives you just what you need to repair oil leaks in the Steering Knuckle.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Oil Seals
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Felts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
